about.policy: The official Japanese (katakana/kanji from ten-sura.com character list, keyword glossary and world map, or the wiki's kanji field) anchors each term's identity. The English canonical form is the official English one. If Yen Press (the licensed English light novel, which covers vols 12-16) agrees with the anime/official-portal romanisation, that form is used. For light-novel-only terms, the Yen Press form is used where it could be verified: the full vol. 16 text is local, but vols 12-15 could only be checked through cover copy. If the official English sources disagree with each other (Ludora/Rudra, Farmus/Falmuth, Thalion/Sarion, Gabil/Gabiru, Dolph/Dorf, Henrietta/Anrietta, Adalman/Adalmann), the canonical form is the direct romanisation of the official katakana that the anime-following wiki and the project already use, and the conflict is recorded. When no official English form exists, the tensura.fandom.com wiki title is used; the wiki is secondary evidence. The Indonesian fan TL of vols 12-15 is used only to explain project variants. Confidence: HIGH = two independent official sources agree, or one official source plus unambiguous katakana. MEDIUM = one official source, or the official sources disagree. LOW = only fan-TL or project evidence.
